entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:1
segments: ¶Then I returned and considered all the oppression that is done under the sun: And look! The tears of the oppressed, But they have no comforter-On the side of their oppressors [there is] power, But they have no comforter.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:2
segments: Therefore I praised the dead who were already dead, More than the living who are still alive.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:3
segments: Yet, better than both [is he] who has never existed, Who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:4
segments: ¶Again, I saw that for all toil and every skillful work a man is envied by his neighbor. This also [is] vanity and grasping for the wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:5
segments: The fool folds his hands And consumes his own flesh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:6
segments: Better a handful [with] quietness Than both hands full, [together with] toil and grasping for the wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:7
segments: ¶Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:8
segments: There is one alone, without companion: He has neither son nor brother. Yet [there is] no end to all his labors, Nor is his eye satisfied with riches. [But he never asks], "For whom do I toil and deprive myself of good?" This also [is] vanity and a grave misfortune.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:9
segments: Two [are] better than one, Because they have a good reward for their labor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:10
segments: For if they fall, one will lift up his companion. But woe to him [who is] alone when he falls, For [he has] no one to help him up.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:11
segments: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; But how can one be warm [alone]?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:12
segments: Though one may be overpowered by another, two can withstand him. And a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:13
segments: ¶Better a poor and wise youth Than an old and foolish king who will be admonished no more.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:14
segments: For he comes out of prison to be king, Although he was born poor in his kingdom.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:15
segments: I saw all the living who walk under the sun; They were with the second youth who stands in his place.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:16
segments: [There was] no end of all the people over whom he was made king; Yet those who come afterward will not rejoice in him. Surely this also [is] vanity and grasping for the wind.
